reasoning: This question asks whether US commercial and industrial (C&I) loans will increase between October 26 and November 2, 2025. The data comes from the Federal Reserve's H.8 release, updated weekly on Wednesdays. The timeframe is only 7 days. C&I loans typically show modest week-to-week changes, with both increases and decreases occurring regularly. Without specific economic shocks or policy changes, there's no strong directional bias. Historically, C&I loans have shown slight growth trends during normal economic periods, but weekly volatility is common. Given the short timeframe and lack of information about intervening economic events, the probability should be close to 50%, with a slight upward bias reflecting the long-term growth trend in C&I lending.
